metadata.title: Marvell Stock, Corning, and Lumentum Surge on Report of Import China Ban<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Marvell Surges as China Ban Report Reignites Optical-Networking Stocks
Marvell Technology and other optical-networking stocks rose sharply on Tuesday. The companies could be about to get relief from Chinese competition.
